create.title: Exact double-Mellin separation of the M1 angular coefficient
create.statement_tex: With z=u+v, tau_(chi4,z)(n)=sum_(hq=n)chi_4(q)h^(-z), and R_X(u,v)=sum_(n<=16sqrt X)tau_(chi4,u+v)(n)n^(-3/4+u/2)e(sqrt(Xn)), every interior active M1 scale is the exact double Mellin integral of W_hat(u)phi_hat(v)(D_j/(2sqrt X))^u(H_j+1)^v R_X(u,v). Floors, odd q, product cutoff, and endpoint stars are retained. The hard top has W_+hat(u)=1/u-(1/u)int_0^1 W'(t)t^u dt; symmetric inversion gives the endpoint half weight, while the 1/u term requires a maximal Perron estimate. Moreover sum_n tau_(chi4,z)(n)n^(-s)=zeta(s+z)L(s,chi_4) for Re s>1 and Re(s+z)>1.
create.next_action: Use the centered angular modes and retain the top 1/u Perron term as a separate maximal-estimate obligation.

create.title: Centered twisted-divisor functional equation and angular reflection
create.statement_tex: Let a_z(n)=n^(z/2)tau_(chi4,z)(n)=sum_(hq=n)chi_4(q)(q/h)^(z/2) and F_z(s)=zeta(s+z/2)L(s-z/2,chi_4). The completion Lambda_z(s)=pi^(-(s+z/2)/2)Gamma((s+z/2)/2)(4/pi)^((s-z/2+1)/2)Gamma((s-z/2+1)/2)F_z(s) has conductor 4, root number +1, and satisfies Lambda_z(s)=Lambda_(-z)(1-s). Thus Voronoi duality reflects a_z to a_(-z). In the Round-15 radial sum, R_X(u,v)=sum_(n<=16sqrt X)a_(u+v)(n)n^(-3/4-v/2)e(sqrt(Xn)); the spatial Mellin variable leaves the radial power exactly.
create.next_action: Test cancellation between the actual z and reflected -z sectors before taking absolute values over Mellin modes.

create.title: Fixed-mode Voronoi is an angular reflection, not a GAR bound
create.statement_tex: The centered functional equation maps a_z to a_(-z), reversing the divisor angle rather than removing it. At z=0 it is the full r_2/4 Hardy--Voronoi return. Existing fixed-parameter Voronoi identities do not provide estimates uniform in the two Mellin heights, and cannot be integrated through the hard top 1/u Perron mode by pointwise bounds alone. Therefore the functional equation by itself proves neither GAR nor a new point of U_1. This does not obstruct signed cancellation between reflected angular sectors under the actual outside-integral mode measure.
create.next_action: Reject fixed-mode black-box Voronoi as a proof; retain the signed z/-z correlation and top Perron maximal problem.

create.title: Reflected angular-mode correlation with top Perron maximal control
create.statement_tex: Prove an X^epsilon bound for the actual outside-integral signed combination of centered radial modes a_z and their functional-equation reflections a_(-z), uniformly under the scale factors, phi_hat(v), and W_hat(u). For the unique top scale, include the symmetric 1/u Perron kernel and prove a maximal truncation bound; pointwise fixed-z estimates are insufficient. Such a theorem would imply the global angular radial estimate GAR after exact residue accounting.
create.next_action: Derive the exact z/-z outside-integral identity including residues and test whether profile complementarity yields cancellation; isolate the top maximal component.

create.title: Twisted-divisor character Voronoi source audit
create.statement_tex: Banerjee--Khurana equation (5.11) gives sum_n overline_sigma_(z,chi)(n)n^(-s)=zeta(s-z)L(s,chi), so tau_(chi4,z)=overline_sigma_(-z,chi4). Their Theorems 4.3--4.4 give fixed-order Voronoi identities for odd primitive characters and analytic finite-interval weights, but no uniform large-imaginary-order or hard-Perron estimate.
create.next_action: Use only for coefficient matching and fixed-parameter identity; do not infer GAR uniformity.

create.title: Double-Dirichlet-series Voronoi source audit
create.statement_tex: Kiral--Zhou Theorem 1.3 supplies a general Voronoi architecture from twisted functional equations, and Example 1.8 treats certain isobaric sums; its main proof is degree at least 3 with a separate degree-2 remark. The project's ramified degree-2 noncuspidal product with a zeta pole is structural analogy rather than a directly matched black-box theorem, and the source gives no mode-integrable complex-shift estimate.
create.next_action: Retain as method architecture only unless all degree-2 polar and ramified hypotheses are separately derived.

reject.reason: The functional equation reflects a_z to a_(-z) and supplies no uniform integrable estimate over both Mellin heights or the hard top 1/u mode.
At z=0 the coefficient is r_2(n)/4 and the radial sum is exactly the Hardy--Voronoi return already equivalent to the target.
The analytic conductor grows with t plus or minus Im(z)/2, phi_hat has a pole near zero, and the top spatial transform has a non-L1 1/u Perron tail.
The exact project family is degree two, ramified, noncuspidal, and polar; the paper's general theorem does not directly supply this specialization or its required complex-shift estimates.
The source gives fixed-order identities under analytic-weight and real-part restrictions, not uniform large-imaginary-order bounds or a hard-Perron maximal theorem.

It isolates the noncircular remaining seam as outside-integral z/-z correlation plus a top Perron maximal theorem, while primary-source review rules out two tempting black-box imports.
